name: ci-doctor
description: Everything your agents need to make CI fast, and keep it that way: a playbook, coding-agent skills and a local GitHub Actions scorer. Your agent measures CI and writes a plan you approve, then fixes failed runs, workflows that waste time, slow and flaky tests, runners, their queues and the bill, and how far an edit reaches, with each speed-up, saving or fix proved before it's quoted, and agents' instructions kept short and true.
